Laplacian with clamped boundary conditions\ndouble computeLaplacian(const std::vector<double>& c, const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,\n                        const double dx, const double dy, const double dz, const size_t x, const size_t y, const size_t z) {\n    const size_t xp = (x < nx - 1) ? x + 1 : x;\n    const size_t yp = (y < ny - 1) ? y + 1 : y;\n    const size_t zp = dz);\n    \n    return cxx + cyy + czz;\n}\n\n// Compute chemical potential\nvoid computeChemicalPotential(const std::vector<double>& c, std::vector<double>& mu,\n                              const idx = idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny);\n                const double cv = c[idx];\n                \n                mu[idx] = 4.5 * ((cv + 1.0) * e_AA + (cv - 1.0) * e_BB - 2.0 * cv * e_AB) \n if (nz == 0) nz = nx;\n    \n    printf(\"Cahn-Hilliard Phase Separation Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Grid size: %zu x %zu x %zu\\n\", nx, ny, nz);\n    printf(\"Time steps: %d\\n\", iterations);\n double dt = 0.01;\n    const double e_AA = -(2.0 / 9.0);\n    const double e_BB = -(2.0 / 9.0);\n    const double e_AB = (2.0 / 9.0);\n    const double gamma = 0.5;\n    const double D = 1.0;\n    \n    size_t gridSize = nx * ny * nz;\n    \n    // Allocate arrays\n    std::vector<double> cold(gridSize);\n    std::vector<double> cnew(gridSize);\n    std::vector<double> mu(gridSize);\n    \n    // {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CfzaEErjipVqKi7MkzQLW","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The benchmark now runs entirely on the GPU. It builds as `cahn_hilliard` from a fresh CMake configure, and its output matches the original CPU code bit for bit when both are compiled with strict IEEE rounding.\n\n**Changes (only the two existing files):**\n- **`cahn-hilliard/cahn_hilliard.cpp`**: the CPU stencil loops are replaced by three CUDA kernels: concentration init, chemical potential, and update. The field stays on the device for all time steps and is copied back once for `-r` and `-v`. Kernels use grid-stride loops, so any grid size works within the CUDA launch limits. If no CUDA device is found, the program prints an error and exits with code 1; there is no CPU fallback.\n- **`cahn-hilliard/CMakeLists.txt`**: enables the CUDA language and compiles the existing `.cpp` as CUDA. It links `CUDA::cudart` and keeps the `-O3 -march=native` host flags. The minimum CMake version is now 3.24. No new files or dependencies.\n\n**Verification:**\n- Output hashes and sums match a reference CPU build (compiled with `-ffp-contract=off`) exactly, across 16³, 64³, 1×1×1, 3×5×7, 17×9×33, 100×3×2, 40×200×1, and zero iterations. Validation passes in all cases.\n- Timing for 20 steps, against the original CPU build:\n\n| Grid | Original | CUDA | Speedup |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| 128³ | 257 ms | 16 ms | ~16× |\n| 256³ | 2006 ms | 129 ms | ~16× |\n| 512³ | 20366 ms | 912 ms | ~22× |\n\n**Choices you may want to revisit:**\n- **FMA disabled (`-fmad=false`)**: The original CPU build fuses multiply-adds under `-march=native`, which changes the last bits of the result. I disabled contraction on the GPU so results match the expressions as written. The original's own hashes differ if it is built with default flags, so output drift is expected between the two builds.\n- **`CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES native`**: CMake needs a visible GPU at configure time. Pass `-DCMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=<arch>` to override.\n- **Timing scope**: the timer covers the time-stepping loop plus a device sync. Initialization and the final device-to-host copy are outside it, matching the original's exclusion of initialization.\n- **Single GPU**: there is no multi-GPU decomposition. Scaling comes from the large number of threads per kernel.\n\n**Not done:** the kernels read global memory directly, reaching roughly 15% of the RTX 3090's peak bandwidth by my estimate. Shared-memory tiling or fusing the two kernels could likely speed it up further, but I did not attempt that.\n\nI built everything in `/tmp` and did not commit. `output.txt` and `common/` are untouched."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1571,"cache_read_input_tokens":55825,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1571},"output_tokens":6,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"6f5ec348-5a52-4439-ba6b-091200cfd952","uuid":"d4a13499-758c-488a-a2df-1a5f8e113b45","timestamp":"2026-10-13T16:45:07.671Z","request_id":"req_011CfzaEE9ovLD6bfAZLKpEm"}
